query: What features can be extracted to train a model to predict a review's score?

per_column.name: text_length
per_column.rationale: Character length is a generic surface feature with weak but non-zero predictive value; derivable directly from Text. Somewhat redundant with word_count.

per_column.name: word_count
per_column.rationale: Word count is a standard length feature, mildly useful and highly redundant with text_length; values match source text.

per_column.name: helpfulness_ratio
per_column.rationale: A genuine new axis derived from HelpfulnessNumerator/Denominator; distinct signal for modeling score.

per_column.name: summary_length
per_column.rationale: Length of Summary; generic surface feature with limited leverage but soundly derived.

per_column.name: exclamation_count
per_column.rationale: Punctuation intensity plausibly correlates with sentiment/score; cleanly extractable from Text.

per_column.name: question_count
per_column.rationale: Mostly zero (near-constant) but captures a weak stylistic signal; grounded in Text.

per_column.name: uppercase_ratio
per_column.rationale: Emphasis/shouting proxy that can relate to sentiment; correctly computed from Text characters.

per_column.name: positive_keyword_count
per_column.rationale: Sentiment lexicon count is directly relevant to predicting score; values are lexicon-dependent so 'great/yummy=2' is sound while some positive rows scored 0, but this is defensible given a fixed keyword list.

per_column.name: negative_keyword_count
per_column.rationale: Negative sentiment count gives useful signal for score prediction; grounded in Text via a keyword list.

per_column.name: review_year
per_column.rationale: Temporal feature extracted from Time; provides a grouping/trend axis and years are plausibly derived from timestamps.

judge.rationale: The added columns are all soundly derived from present fields (Text, Summary, Helpfulness*, Time) with no observed hallucinations; a 'silent' row correctly yields 0 counts. Analytically the set mixes strong signals (helpfulness_ratio, sentiment keyword counts, exclamation, year) with several generic/redundant length features (text_length, word_count, summary_length) that add limited leverage for score prediction. Overall the columns provide genuine modeling features and are well grounded.
